h1: Custom Full Color Pennants for Your Brand
metaTitle: Custom Full Color Pennants | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom full color pennants for events, promotions, and branding. Perfect Imprints offers bulk pricing and fast turnaround.
introHtml: Full color printing on pennants allows you to reproduce logos, photos, and intricate designs with vivid detail. Unlike single-color or screen-printed options, full color sublimation captures gradients and fine text, making it ideal for commemorative events, trade show giveaways, or retail displays. Choose from standard sizes like 12x18 or custom dimensions, and finish with a pole sleeve or hemmed edges for a polished look.
heroAltText: Custom full color pennants with printed logos and designs for promotional events
